resources.string: Modular enhancement framework for WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business.

WaEnhancer X is an advanced Xposed module designed and developed by Mubashar Dev that elevates your WhatsApp experience with cutting-edge privacy features, aesthetic customization, and powerful tools.

1. Ensure that your device is rooted.
2. Install the Xposed Framework on your device.
3. Download the WaEnhancer X from the Actions section.
4. Install the WaEnhancer X APK.
5. Enable the WaEnhancer X module in the Xposed Installer app.
If you encounter any issues or have questions about WaEnhancer X, please visit Telegram.
